## Sensibilidad a valores atípicos: demostración

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| fig-width: 11
#| fig-height: 4.0
#| fig-align: center
set.seed(8)
x_normal  <- rnorm(20, mean=5, sd=0.8)
x_outlier <- c(x_normal, 12.5)   # un outlier extremo

par(mfrow=c(1,2), mar=c(4, 4, 3, 1), family="sans")

# Sin outlier
ic1 <- mean(x_normal) + c(-1,1)*qt(0.975,length(x_normal)-1)*
       sd(x_normal)/sqrt(length(x_normal))
boxplot(x_normal, horizontal=TRUE, col="#bbf7d0",
        main=paste0("Sin outlier  IC: [",round(ic1[1],2),", ",round(ic1[2],2),"]"),
        xlab="Rendimiento (ton/ha)", cex.main=1.0)
segments(ic1[1],1,ic1[2],1, col="#1e3a8a", lwd=3)
points(mean(x_normal),1,pch=18,cex=2,col="#1e3a8a")

# Con outlier
ic2 <- mean(x_outlier) + c(-1,1)*qt(0.975,length(x_outlier)-1)*
       sd(x_outlier)/sqrt(length(x_outlier))
boxplot(x_outlier, horizontal=TRUE, col="#fad8d8",
        main=paste0("Con outlier  IC: [",round(ic2[1],2),", ",round(ic2[2],2),"]"),
        xlab="Rendimiento (ton/ha)", cex.main=1.0)
segments(ic2[1],1,ic2[2],1, col="#dc2626", lwd=3)
points(mean(x_outlier),1,pch=18,cex=2,col="#dc2626")

cat("Amplitud sin outlier:", round(diff(ic1),3), "\n")
cat("Amplitud con outlier:", round(diff(ic2),3), "\n")
```
